plan.notes: Official Greensboro College 2026-2027 Undergraduate Academic Catalog. The catalog publishes degree requirements with no official semester sequence for this program - collected as a single requirements block (requirements_only). This plan covers the major requirements only (Required Courses plus Required Related Courses as printed); Greensboro College requires a minimum of 124 total credit hours for the degree, the balance being general education, all-college/disciplinary requirements and free electives, which are not part of this major block. Where the catalog prints only a block subtotal for a choose-from group, the group is recorded as one choice slot at the printed subtotal with the options named in the choice note; no per-option credits were invented. Catalog pp.262-263. The catalog text states the major includes a minimum of 49 hours of coursework; its printed total for the B.S. degree, including the 8-credit Required Related block, is 57. Five core PHM courses are taught through the Lower Cost Model of Independent Colleges Consortium (LCMC) utilizing Rize Education, online with optional online synchronous sessions, as printed. SOC 1010 is printed in this section with the title Social Imagination.
